name: Seefelder Music Spring
beschreibung: The Seefelder Music Festival welcomes spring with open concerts, street music, and a music picnic in the Kurpark. Whether you prefer folk music, jazz, or something in between, there’s something for every taste. A vibrant weekend perfect for the whole family.
kurzbeschreibung: Spring awakening with music, concerts, and a music picnic in the Seefelder Health Resort Park.
